description.en: concrete pump integral piston φ160 is restated under Taraxacum. A φ160 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ160 as its piston.

h1.en: One concrete pump integral piston φ160 row, sequenced like Taraxacum
h1.zh: 只有concrete pump integral piston φ160这一行，次序仿《Taraxacum》

directAnswer.en: Taraxacum is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump integral piston φ160 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. A φ160 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ160 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 《Taraxacum》是百科页。concrete pump integral piston φ160仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ160 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ160 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Etymology”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ160. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ160 is not on the split-piston list. Do not switch the order to a split set. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“词源”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ160。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。φ160 不在分体活塞清单里。不要改成订分体套件。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Read “Description” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ160, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 把“描述”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ160 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The heading “Classification” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. A φ160 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ160 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 标题“分类”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 φ160 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ160 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “History”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“历史”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Ecology”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Ecology”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The heading “Cultivation” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taraxacum
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Cultivation”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taraxacum

question.en: Can the outline heading “Cultivation” rename concrete pump integral piston φ160?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Cultivation”可以改掉concrete pump integral piston φ160的名称吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
